What can I get you?|The Mon Calamari server, to Din Djarin|}} A [[Mon Calamari]] '''server''' was a worker at an [[Unidentified inn (Trask)|inn]] at a port on the [[moon]] [[Trask]]. In [[9 ABY]], the server saw the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] to his seat and provided confirmation, upon payment of [[Calamari Flan]], that other Mandalorians had been present at the port, also serving the [[foundling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] some [[Trask Chowder]]. The Mon Calamari then introduced Djarin to a [[Quarren]] [[Unidentified Quarren boatman|boatman]] who had seen the other Mandalorians. ==Biography== {{Quote|Have you seen others that look like me?''"
"''Others with beskar have been through here.''"
"''Who can take me to them?''"
"''I know someone that might help.|Din Djarin and the Mon Calamari server|}} [[File:MonCalServerWaves-TMCh11.png|thumb|left|300px|The Mon Calamari greets a patron entering his inn.]] During the [[New Republic]]'s [[New Republic Era|reign]], the [[Mon Calamari]] worked as a server in an [[Unidentified inn (Trask)|inn]] at the black market port on the [[Water|estuary]] [[moon]] of [[Trask]]. The server at some point became aware of some [[Mandalorian]]s which passed through the port in [[9 ABY]].{{MandoDate|11}} Soon after, the Mon Calamari was working at the inn when the [[Querm Rybet|frog-like]] [[alien]] "[[Frog Man]]" guided the Mandalorian [[Din Djarin]] there. The server, after waving to Frog Man, saw the Mandalorian and his [[foundling]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 13: The Jedi}} to a table and asked what they wanted. Djarin only asked for [[Trask Chowder]] for Grogu, and the Mon Calamari insisted that whoever was seated must eat. The Mandalorian instead offered [[Calamari Flan]] for information on the sighted Mandalorians that had been on Trask. Serving Grogu chowder through a tube, the server confirmed to Djarin that other Mandalorians had passed through the port. Djarin asked if someone could take him to them, and so the Mon Calamari approached a [[Quarren]] [[Unidentified Quarren boatman|boatman]] who had seen the Mandalorians. After learning from the server about Djarin and his business, the Quarren approached the Mandalorian and offered to take him aboard his [[boat]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Nothing for me. A bowl of chowder for my friend.''"
"''These seats are scarce, buddy. Everyone seated needs to eat.|Din Djarin and the Mon Calamari server|}} [[File:MonCalServerPoints-TMCh11.png|thumb|right|300px|The server points out Din Djarin to the Quarren.]] The server was a Mon Calamari with [[Color|red]] skin and orange [[eye]]s. The server was insistent that every seated guest at the inn had to eat due to how scarce available seats were. The Mon Calamari accepted information as one such export to allow Djarin to keep his seat after receiving payment from the Mandalorian. ==Equipment== {{Quote|He's wearing beskar.|The Mon Calamari server, to a Quarren boatman|}} The server wore brown [[clothing]] with a red [[scarf]] and used a tube to serve chowder to patrons at the inn. ==Behind the scenes== The Mon Calamari server appeared in "[[Chapter 11: The Heiress]]" of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Bryce Dallas Howard]] and released on [[November 13]], [[2020]].{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}} Credited as "Mon Calarmari Server," the character was portrayed by [[Norwood Cheek]]. ==Appearances== *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 Junior Novel|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' Junior Novel]] *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 11: The Heiress}} {{1st}} *[[The Mandalorian Season 2 3|''The Mandalorian Season 2'' 3]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Servidor mon calamari no identificado |fr=Serveur Mon Calamari non identifié |ja=名称不明のモン・カラマリの給仕 |ka=უცნობი მონ კალამარი მიმტანი }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Mon Calamari]] [[Category:Waiters]]
